title: Naïve raises $28.5M to automate the grunt work of setting up and running a company
author: Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: Taking vibe-coding a step further, Naïve claims its infra can automate most of the work in setting up and running a business.
body:
## Automation of Business Setup and Operations
Naïve, a startup, has secured $28.5 million in funding to further develop its infrastructure that enables AI agents to automate the setup and running of businesses. This technology allows developers to provision infrastructure, including payments, email accounts, phone numbers, and cloud storage, through a single API. By providing a prompt to tools like Cursor, Claude Code, or Codex, developers can connect to Naïve's API and have their AI agents set up a business, including forming a U.S. LLC and configuring necessary services.

## How the Technology Works
The process involves supplying AI agents with a token budget and using Naïve's API to orchestrate the setup of a business. The agents can handle tasks such as setting up email inboxes, virtual cards, phone numbers, databases, and connections to services like Stripe and QuickBooks. A governance layer ensures that users can set budgets, restrict agent capabilities, and require human approval for sensitive actions. Naïve also provides templates for various business types, including AI SEO, full-stack SaaS apps, and customer support.

## Impact on Developers and Researchers
The automation of business setup and operations has significant implications for developers and researchers. With Naïve's infrastructure, they can focus on high-level tasks and strategy, rather than tedious setup and maintenance. The company's rapid growth, with over 30,000 developer customers and a 10x increase in annual run-rate revenue, demonstrates the demand for such automation. As AI technology continues to advance, Naïve's platform is poised to play a key role in enabling the creation of autonomous businesses and streamlining operations.
